name: audio-master
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server & tools for professional audio mastering, vocal cleanup, and sidechain ducking.

tools.name: master_audio
tools.description: Applies the 5-stage studio vocal chain (rumble cut, de-esser, lowpass, SOXR 48kHz resampler, EBU R128 loudnorm) to any audio file.

input_file.description: Absolute path to the input audio file.

target_lufs.description: Target integrated loudness in LUFS (-19 for audiobooks, -16 for podcasts). Default: -19.

tools.name: sidechain_duck_audio
tools.description: Dynamically ducks background music under spoken dialogue using FFmpeg sidechain compression.

vocal_file.description: Spoken dialogue or narration audio track.

bgm_file.description: Background score or ambient music track.

output_file.description: Path to the final mastered output file.

duck_attenuation_db.description: Volume attenuation in dB applied to BGM during speech. Default: -16.0.

tools.name: audit_audio_levels
tools.description: Runs FFmpeg astats filter to extract RMS level, True Peak, dynamic range, and DC offset.

audio_file.description: Path to the audio file to inspect.
